title: Should You Use a Standing Desk?

sentences: The human body evolved to forage and hunt on the African savannahs, not to sit in a cubicle all day.
The risks associated with sitting — from increased blood-sugar levels to greater odds of dying from cancer — lead many health authorities to warn against spending too much time doing so.
The sit-to-stand desk is a popular way of helping people get upright.
But how effective is it?
translations: 人类的身体进化是为了在非洲大草原上觅食和狩猎，而不是整天坐在隔间里。
久坐带来的风险——从血糖水平升高到死于癌症的几率增加——导致许多卫生机构警告人们不要花太多时间坐着。
坐立两用办公桌是一种帮助人们站起来的流行方式。
但它有多有效呢？

sentences: Several arguments are made in its favour.
As standing makes the heart work harder, proponents say it improves cardiovascular health, enhances attention and reduces fatigue.
Physiotherapists claim that standing also improves posture, reducing lower back pain.
Some studies even suggest that standing workers report lower stress and greater happiness than sitters do.
translations: 支持这一做法有几个理由。
由于站立会使心脏工作更费力，支持者称这能改善心血管健康、增强注意力并减少疲劳。
理疗师声称站立还能改善姿势，减轻下背部疼痛。
一些研究甚至表明，站立工作的员工比久坐的员工报告的压力更低、幸福感更高。

sentences: Dozens of studies have been run on the potential health effects of sit-stand desks.
A recent review, led by María Eugenia Visier-Alfonso at University of Castilla-La Mancha in Spain and published in BMC Public Health in May, selected 17 for examination.
Dr Visier-Alfonso limited her analysis to those that looked mainly at university students.
translations: 关于坐站两用办公桌对健康的潜在影响，已有数十项研究进行过探讨。
最近一项由西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰大学的玛丽亚·尤金妮亚·维西尔-阿方索领导、并于五月发表在《BMC公共卫生》上的综述，筛选了17项研究进行审查。
维西尔-阿方索博士将她的分析限定在主要关注大学生的研究上。

sentences: Of the four studies that looked at mental health, three confirmed that sit-stand desk use reduced anxiety and improved mood.
Of the four on back pain, however, only one revealed significant pain reduction among sit-stand desk users compared with control groups.
The one study Dr Visier-Alfonso found that looked at the cardiovascular and metabolic benefits of sit-stand desks suggested that they do result in users having lower blood pressure.
(The remainder mostly looked at academic outcomes, which were mixed.)
translations: 在四项关注心理健康的研究中，有三项证实使用坐站两用桌能减轻焦虑并改善情绪。
然而，在四项关于背痛的研究中，只有一项显示，与对照组相比，使用坐站两用桌的用户疼痛显著减轻。
Visier-Alfonso博士发现的那项关注坐站两用桌对心血管和代谢益处的研究表明，这些桌子确实能使用户血压降低。
（其余研究主要关注学业成绩，结果好坏参半。）

sentences: Studies conducted on more varied groups reach different conclusions.

A general review of over 50 papers on sit-stand desk use, led by April Chambers at the University of Pittsburgh and published in Applied Ergonomics in 2019, found only weak evidence that their use improves cardiovascular health.
translations: 针对更多样化群体进行的研究得出了不同的结论。
由匹兹堡大学的April Chambers领导并于2019年发表在《应用人体工程学》上的一项对50多篇关于坐站两用桌使用情况的论文的总体回顾发现，只有微弱的证据表明使用它们能改善心血管健康。

sentences: The heart rates of sit-stand desk users were 7.5-13.7 beats per minute faster on average than those of people at ordinary desks, indicating that they might be working harder.
But the studies that examined the question found no notable differences in blood pressure or VO2 (the efficiency with which the body transports oxygen to the muscles).
translations: 坐站两用办公桌使用者的平均心率比普通办公桌使用者每分钟快7.5至13.7次，表明他们可能工作更努力。
但研究该问题的研究发现，在血压或VO2（身体将氧气输送到肌肉的效率）方面没有显著差异。

sentences: Analysis of other health-related biomarkers, like glucose, insulin and cholesterol, were also no different in most studies.
This suggested that the desks were not providing metabolic benefits that might, say, stave off diseases like type 2 diabetes.
Improvements in levels of energy and attention among those who used sit-stand desks were similarly difficult to spot.
What's more, Dr Chambers found no evidence that their use influenced mood.
translations: 对葡萄糖、胰岛素和胆固醇等其他健康相关生物标志物的分析在大多数研究中也未发现差异。
这表明这些办公桌并未提供可能预防2型糖尿病等疾病的代谢益处。
在使用坐立式办公桌的人群中，能量水平和注意力的改善同样难以察觉。
此外，钱伯斯博士没有发现任何证据表明使用它们会影响情绪。

sentences: However, notable benefits did emerge in the area of lower-back pain.
Of 17 papers that studied this question, eight revealed evidence that giving participants the option to stand significantly reduced their lower-back pain (the remaining nine showed no clear effect).
This suggests that standing may help some people with this condition, an effect that may be more noticeable among people past university age.
translations: 然而，在下背痛领域确实出现了显著的好处。
在17篇研究这一问题的论文中，有8篇提供了证据，表明让参与者选择站立显著减轻了他们的下背痛（其余9篇未显示明显效果）。
这表明站立可能对某些患有此病的人有帮助，这种效果在大学毕业年龄以上的人群中可能更为明显。

sentences: So what is the aching desk jockey to do?
Both reviews agree that no significant harm is associated with the use of sit-stand desks.
And although some of the differences between their conclusions may stem from chance or sample size, it is also possible that different benefits accrue to users of different ages.
translations: 那么，腰酸背痛的办公族该怎么办呢？
两项综述都认为，使用坐站两用办公桌不会带来显著危害。
尽管它们结论中的一些差异可能源于偶然因素或样本量大小，但不同年龄段的用户也可能获得不同的益处。
